title: pityrogramma pallida
intro: Pityrogramma pallida, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern native to Southeast Asia and Australia. This plant is known for its unique ability to thrive in a variety of environments and is often used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits. Studies have shown that Pityrogramma pallida has therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
